item.title: Spiritual Resolve for Fearless Living at Eternal Gandhi Museum Houston
item.description:
Sunday, August 16, 2026 at 10 AM

Location: Eternal Gandhi Museum Houston, 12379 Riceville School Rd, Houston, 77031, United States

Self Enquiry Life Fellowship presents Spiritual Resolve for Fearless Living: Guided Meditation & Lecture by Himalayan Monk, HH Swami Vidyadhishananda at Eternal Gandhi Museum Houston. His Holiness Swami Vidyadhishananda, a Himalayan monk and Sanskritist, will lead a sacred Sunday morning centered on the theme of spiritual resilience and resolve amidst unstable times. Through direct experience of guided meditation, along with words of wisdom and spiritual advice, guests will take home meaningful guidance about spiritual resolve and resilience amidst the challenges and the difficult times ahead. The fellowship invites all to discover the steady ground of spiritual wisdom and contemplative practice, timeless anchors that hold firm through any challenge. The morning will open with sublime Sanskrit chanting by His Holiness, followed by guided meditation, words of wisdom, a blessing line, and more. A light Vegetarian lunch will be provided in the foyer during the blessing line. Doors at 9:30am. Admission Tickets are $15.
